$comment: VERIFIED image records for the Drew1011 storytime. Each image was opened and described. IMPORTANT: the original order-based mapping was WRONG for markers 1-24 (a forum post split across two images has no Image marker in the transcript, so everything drifted); it is correct from marker 25 on. Use depicts + correctedContext to decide what an image shows and where it belongs — never the ordinal position. Entries with excluded set must not be published.

images.depicts: Guild emblem artwork on white. A stylised upraised hand rendered in dark teal with bright green/emerald fingertips (evoking 'Liquid Emerald'). Beneath it, in dark teal caps: 'HOLDERS OF LE' and, in smaller letterspaced caps, 'A VALKYRIE MEMBER-GUILD'. No dates, players or territory counts visible. NOTE: the 'A Valkyrie member-guild' tagline dates this artwork to HoL's Valkyrie-alliance era (2016), well after the May-September 2015 events the adjacent text describes.
images.usableFor: holders-of-le - guild emblem (caption must note the artwork is the later Valkyrie-era version of the logo)

images.depicts: Screenshot of a Wynncraft forums post by user 'Kuroi'. Left sidebar: avatar is a black-and-white photograph of Spock (Leonard Nimoy); username 'Kuroi'; user title 'Amateur Quantum Engineer'; stats 'Messages: 203', 'Likes Received: 1,536', 'Trophy Points: 78', 'Guild: HoL', 'Minecraft: Kur0i'. Body verbatim: "Hi Spham, we got your msg's :P. / Alright, so we wanted to ask you something about... yosteric5. / 'We' being kategajda , @Drew1011, and a few other members, and all of us absolutely despise him. / You probably know yosteric5, he's the stand-in leader of HoL, our guild. / Basically, he's an absolutely horrible leader, and we want to change that. / We're asking you to convince our guild leader, @SSEEBBYZ , to kick him out of the guild or demote him. Being leader of Fuq, we're pretty sure you can get SSEEBBYZ to do that... / Also, I think he essentially insulted Fuq rather recently. / We would have loved to ally ourselves with Kangronomicon, but yosteric pretty much... ruined that chance? Anyway, I hope he didn't completely. We're really counting on your help here. / ~kuroiwanko617". Names visible: Kuroi / kuroiwanko617 / Kur0i, Spham, yosteric5, kategajda, Drew1011, SSEEBBYZ. Guild tags: HoL, Fuq (Kangronomicon).
images.usableFor: holders-of-le - primary evidence for the 'Secret HoL Illuminati Society' plot against yosteric5; also kuroi, spham, yosteric5, sseebbyz person pages

He had added Spham and myself to a group chat and sent this:' (that position has NO 'Image' marker in the extracted text, which is what throws the rest of the sequence off). It is the top half of the same forum post whose bottom half is file 04-image; the next line, 'And although it was later revealed that the Ezura (Validus leader) quote was an edited quote', refers directly to the quote block shown here. It is provisionally sitting at the part break at line 80, where it makes no sense.
images.depicts: Screenshot of a Wynncraft forums post header plus a quote block. Header: Minecraft-skin avatar, username 'tangler', user title 'The Mythical Rebel with Slayer V'. Quote block headed 'Ezura said:' containing verbatim: "HoL.... / THOSE TRAITOROUS ******* SCUM! / The most loyal of my guild friends. / I CAN'T BELIEVE THOSE IDIOTS HAVE BEEN NEGOTIATING WITH LEGIO BEHIND MY BACK! / Holders. / I can't believe what they have done. / WHILE I'M PRAISING THEM FOR BEING OUR MOST LOYAL, BOOT LICKING KISS ASS MILITARY ALLIES, THEY ARE NEGOTIATING WITH OUR ******* ENEMIES! / But all those traitors will pay... images.correctedContext: Belongs with file 03-image at drew1011-storytime.md line 96 ('He had added Spham and myself to a group chat and sent this:'). This is the lower half of the SAME tangler post - it explains the asterisks in the Ezura quote shown in 03 - and carries the byline 'tangler, Aug 16, 2015', matching the narrative's dating of the HoL/Kangronomicon defection to 15 August 2015. It is provisionally sitting at line 130, 'Here is the aftermath of the attack', which is an October territory-map slot.
images.depicts: Screenshot of the body of a Wynncraft forums post, verbatim: "Ezura says no. Asterisks inserted to prevent damage to eyes, lol. BTW, he means 'Kick-ass'. / Now, I've been saying that Drew's betrayal has greatly limited our options to the current choice of joining FUQ as an ally, joining TNA's call to att FUQ in their weakness, or just dropping out of guild terrs entirely. / Perhaps I could have brought Ezura around to see the sense of the first option. He does calm down eventually. Perhaps I could have succeeded. But a Betrayer like Drew can never bring himself to trust someone he has betrayed, I should have realized. So, I'm not inclined to try to persuade Ezura to give Drew another chance, and will act on his instructions accordingly. What a waste, now we all get to fight while TNA laughs . . . / I give you an hour's notice, an hour more than Drew gave me." Post footer reads 'tangler, Aug 16, 2015' with 'Report' and 'Reply' links. Names: tangler, Ezura, Drew; guilds FUQ (Kangronomicon), TNA (Nether's Ascent).

images.correctedContext: This is Drew1011's message announcing HoL's departure from Ordo Malleus. It belongs at drew1011-storytime.md lines 454-455 - 'And so on March 9th, 2016, at approximately 5:27 PM EST, I took the match burning in the house and poured gasoline on it.' (that position has no 'Image' marker in the extraction; the nearest available slot is the part break at line 392). Line 500 confirms the image existed: 'This message had a much more lighthearted tone than the Ordo one'. It is provisionally sitting at line 287, the Vesta part break.
images.depicts: Screenshot of a long plain-text message (black on white, no client chrome). Verbatim: "Hello. So after HHU and TnP left, this alliance quickly became something it never should be. In my opinion, instead of this alliance being a balance between all the guilds, it become more of a dictatorship between Kru and Arenos. HHU and TnP were two of HoL's best friends. It is a known fact that the alliance was largely ran by Fuq, HHU, HoL, Tnp, and Snr. These were the original guilds, and were the most respected Ordo guilds. There was an issue that these guilds were split on. You can probably guess what it is. When HHU and TnP left, HoL was the only one left on one side of the issue. It is in my opinion that this caused the issue to grow, and I was powerless against it, with nobody on my side. I have begun to see Ordo for what it is, a group of people who judge everyone else, and look down upon every other person, and believe that this alliance is no longer beneficial to HoL. I regret to inform the leaders of Ordo Malleus that HoL will be leaving the alliance to pursue other interests. This alliance has been a great experience, and I wish some of you the best in your future endeavors. I don't want you to think I am taking this decision lightly. I have been sitting here for about 10 minutes trying to make myself hit the send button. To the people here I enjoy talking to and spending time with (you know who you are), I'm sorry." Guild tags: HHU, TnP, HoL, Fuq, Tnp, Snr. Names: Kru, Arenos.
images.usableFor: ordo-malleus - the verbatim leaving message that triggered the alliance's collapse on 9 March 2016; also holders-of-le and drew1011

images.correctedContext: Belongs at drew1011-storytime.md line 499, immediately after 'the next day I sent my leaving message to the Valkyrie Parliament. Here it is:' - the following line then reads 'This message had a much more lighthearted tone than the Ordo one'. It is provisionally sitting at line 392, one slot early.
images.depicts: Screenshot of a long plain-text message (black on white, 'HoL' underlined twice by a spellchecker). Verbatim: "I regret to inform that HoL will be leaving Valkyrie. I know y'all thought I had probable prospect of permanence, and believe me, I did. I was planning on staying forever. However, something has happened, and I am afraid HoL will be leaving VA. I don't really want to go down in history as the first (and probably only) guild to ever leave Valkyrie, but I am. Don't get me wrong, I've had a great time with y'all, and please don't hate me for this or anything, even though I know that is likely how this will end. I believe that Ari and Kv will (hopefully) be the most understanding of this, as much like Imp leaving Legio to create Valkyrie with Fox, HoL will be leaving Valkyrie to create Halcyon with TnP. Please, do not let this affect your opinion of HHU or Red's probable prospect of permanence, as he did not even know of this until about an hour ago, and has assured me that he will not leave and will stay with Valkyrie. I have already changed the HoL thread back to the original, and will remove the HoL art that Ari so graciously created for us from all the places where it is. I do not want to have any beef with anyone here, although I feel like that is inevitable, and I would completely understand if you hate me for this. You have my word that I will not share any private VA information with anyone, as I ain't no snitch. I do not know if there is any protocol for leaving this alliance, since it has never been done before, so I will just leave this chat and all y'all's chats, and if there is protocol or something I need to do, message me. Viva Valkyrie!" Names: Ari, Kv, Red. Guilds/alliances: HoL, Valkyrie/VA, Imp, Legio, Fox, Halcyon, TnP, HHU.
images.usableFor: valkyrie-alliance / halcyon-alliance - the verbatim message by which HoL became the first guild ever to leave Valkyrie, 5 June 2016; also confirms Ari drew HoL's guild art

Here is the message that was sent:'. It is provisionally sitting at line 560, the Valkyrie coup part break, one slot early.
images.depicts: Screenshot of a long plain-text message (black on white). Verbatim: "Yuno, / I think that to say Valkyrie is thriving, or even alive for that matter, would be a complete and total lie. It is not a secret that lately the alliance has gone down the drain. We believe this to be a combination of many things. However, some of them can be fixed, and that is what we intend to do here. We know that your schedule has been highly erratic lately and that your inactivity may not be your fault. However, you have also overused your power and done things that not all of us agreed with. For example, you created the war alliance. While we were informed of it, we were not given an accurate description and agreed to it because we thought it was what everyone else wanted. Then, you added the Wybel Kingdom to it. You knew that not everyone was on good terms with the Kingdom's leaders, yet they were added anyways. I do not think anyone was consulted on this matter until after the fact. Therefore, we believe it to be in Valkyrie's best interests if you step down from your position and focus your attention on leading Imperial, not Valkyrie. We do not mean this message to be aggressive or hostile. We are asking you, as a friend, to relinquish your position as Valkyrie leader, and allow someone else to take the torch, post the thread, and take Valkyrie back in the direction of glory. / -A Unanimous Declaration from the Leaders of Valkyrie" Names/entities: Yuno, Valkyrie, Wybel Kingdom, Imperial.
images.usableFor: valkyrie-alliance - the first ultimatum of the Valkyrie coup asking Yuno to step down (verbatim); also yuno, imperial

images.correctedContext: Belongs at drew1011-storytime.md line 570, immediately after 'I wrote a second message in response, made sure we all agreed, and sent it. That message was as follows:'. It is provisionally sitting at line 567 ('Here is the message that was sent:' - the FIRST message), one slot early.
images.depicts: Screenshot of a plain-text message (black on white). Verbatim: "Yuno, / I think that maybe our point did not get across to you. The 'asking you as a friend' part of the message was only a formality. That was added to stop things from escalating further. The truth is, however, that we are not really 'asking' you to step down. We are telling you to. Three out of four leaders support this cause. We also have the endorsement of Ari. Yuno, do not think that we won't take you up on the 'if you don't like it then leave' statement. If we all leave, you won't even have an alliance to lead." Names: Yuno, Ari.
images.usableFor: valkyrie-alliance - the second, escalated coup ultimatum to Yuno (verbatim), confirming a three-of-four leader majority plus Ari's endorsement

images.correctedContext: Belongs at marker 23 (drew1011-storytime.md line 576), after 'Thus, I drafted a response. In said response we "called his bluff" and continued to push our agenda.' The actual second message is 22-image.png, which answers Yuno's 'if you don't like it then leave' remark.
images.depicts: Plain black-on-white text screenshot of a message addressed to Yuno from the Valkyrie guild leaders. Verbatim: "Yuno, / Your experience as part of the Valkyrie government for over a year has definitely not shown in your leadership. If the cost of Valkyrie returning to its former glory is Imperial leaving it, then so be it. Not one of us have a problem with that, and we believe that the benefits far outweigh the consequences. Unlike what you have done with this alliance, every decision and every message that has  been made/sent regarding this current ordeal has been done with the unanimous consent of every other guild leader, and this message is no different. If the price of this change is the loss of Imperial, then that is a price we are all willing to take."
images.usableFor: valkyrie-alliance -- the autumn 2016 coup against Yuno and the departure of Imperial [Imp]
